subject: Leadership QBR prep — consolidated runway inputs & account one-pagers
messages:
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Melissa O'Neal <melissa@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: 2027-01-10T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Leadership QBR prep — consolidated runway inputs & account one-pagers

Team —

As leadership and product head check in next week, I need a concise, consolidated view of our sales runway tied to the OKR checkpoints. Please do the following for your accounts/owners by EOD Monday 1/11: 

- Populate the attached QBR_account_template.xlsx for each named account (ACV, ARR equivalent, rep-owned forecast, current probability, key milestone to close).
- Add a one-paragraph account summary (status, blockers, next 2 actions, key contact).
- Tag each account with a risk level (green/amber/red) and a short rationale — leadership wants the top 12 accounts by risk and motion called out in the QBR.

Karthik & Marissa: can you own consolidation? Karthik — please prepare the consolidated rollup and a 1-slide leadership summary with the Top 10 high-risk accounts and one-line recommended plays for each. Tessa — we will use your leadership matrix to prioritize escalations; please confirm the fields you want surfaced.

Melissa/Tom (external) — I included you for visibility on the Novariatech thread; we will sync separately on the commercial ask.

Attachments: QBR_account_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks — short and punchy is best here. I will use the consolidated sheet in the leadership readout on Wednesday.

—David
David Kim
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-10T09:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Leadership QBR prep — consolidated runway inputs & account one-pagers

Got it. Quick clarification: for forecast column do you want ACV (annualized new ACV) or ARR (run-rate)? Also, do we standardize "probability" to 0/25/50/75/90 buckets or use rep-provided percentages?

I'll start outreach to owners and push a reminder.

—Marissa

Date: 2027-01-10T10:13:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Leadership QBR prep — consolidated runway inputs & account one-pagers

I can own consolidation. Suggestions: 

- Use ACV as primary for the rollup (makes comp and ramp easier to reconcile) and include an ARR column for reference.
- Standardize probability into 5 buckets (0/25/50/75/90) and map rep percentages to the nearest bucket for the leadership deck.
- I'll create a master tab for the rollup and an "Executive Top 10" tab with one-line plays.

Can we push return deadline to end of day Tues 1/12? I want to do a quick reconciliation pass and flag any splits/duplicate entries before the leadership PDF is generated. If leadership needs it earlier I can deliver a preliminary pass Monday evening.

Attachment: [Kanban board: QBR_account_collection] (link in Drive)

—Karthik
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-10T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Leadership QBR prep — consolidated runway inputs & account one-pagers

Thanks David — this looks good. For leadership I want the following surfaced in the one-slide summary: 

- Top 10 accounts by combined risk (probability * qualitative risk tag)
- Motion required (e.g., exec intro, procurement unblock, legal redline)
- Expected close window (Q1 mid / Q1 end / Q2) and confidence level

I'll attach the Leadership_runway_matrix.pdf for the team to align field names. Please ensure owners populate the "motion required" field — that will drive escalation. Karthik — take point on mapping fields into the slide template; Marissa please monitor owner responses.

Attachment: Leadership_runway_matrix.pdf

—Tessa
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Tom Becker <tom.becker@novariatech.com>
Date: 2027-01-11T08:14:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Leadership QBR prep — consolidated runway inputs & account one-pagers

Looping Tom in for Novariatech visibility — Tom, appreciate your patience. We are preparing our internal QBR materials and will surface the forecast/next milestones in the consolidated rollup; this is internal to Redwood leadership. If you want to run through the play we can do a 20 minute sync after we share the consolidated ask (I expect that by EOD Tue).

Marissa — please send the template and a reminder to the account owners now (tracked in the Kanban). Karthik — please confirm you'll aim for a clean consolidated file by EOD Tue 1/12 and a leadership slide deck by Wed morning.

—David
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

- Total committed ACV in scope: $6.2M (pipeline coverage for Q1 target = 1.9x)
- High-risk accounts (red): 7 accounts totaling $1.8M ACV — primary drivers: procurement windows and legal negotiations.
- Top immediate plays: exec intro (3 accounts), procurement acceleration (2 accounts), feature clarification call (2 accounts).

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBRprep_example
